reviews.content:
Love the idea, but it would be more likely to be my daily driver for screenshot management only if the popup dialog was a bit more detailed (having a dark mode (i keep getting flashbanged), showing a preview, path, and name of the image in the dialog aswell). or better yet, acted as the image in the details tab, like a notification with multiple options would be cool!

to rephrase that, it would be very helpful to see it being more customizable. having all of what i said above, plus what you have implemented, individually toggleable (eg: choosing what popup or notification item is preselected or what clicking the notification does).

my nitpicking aside, im a happy user of this, every so often it comes in handy to reenable <3
